sentence: This project studies how purple sea urchins and other intertidal species adapt to environmental change and what that means for coastal ecosystems.
This project builds a framework for edge devices to train a global model together while protecting data privacy.
This project develops algorithms for solving partial differential equations using ideas from differential geometry.
This project combines computational methods with experiments at ultra-high temperatures to develop phase diagrams for materials with many components.
This project uses a model grass species to study how plant genetics and the environment interact during plant growth and stress.
This project tests how wildfire and forest structure interact to affect the resilience of temperate maritime forests.
This project builds tools that predict the behavior of unmanned aerial vehicles and identify suspicious activities.
This project studies how plants respond to salt-rich dust storms from dry lakebeds, using hyperspectral imaging and deep learning.
This project studies how humans learn patterns while taking part in an active task and without explicit instruction.
This project builds computational tools that work out object shape and optical properties from images using a simulator of how light propagates.
This project develops mathematical methods to analyze field concentration in high-contrast composite materials.
This project develops Digital Twins, which are replicas of machines or processes, to predict product quality in manufacturing.
This project studies how defects start cracks in an aluminum matrix nanocomposite made by laser-based additive manufacturing.
This project develops a way to break down persistent man-made compounds in waste streams using ultrasound and Argon nanobubbles.
This project studies how mixotrophs in the Southern Ocean meet their nutritional needs under iron and manganese limitation.
This project studies the evolution of toothed whale vocal repertoires and how social and environmental factors affect their diversity.
This project develops resource management for serverless platforms that takes security into account as well as performance.
